globalContract.provenanceRule: Every accepted record names provider, route version, stable source identity, occurrence range, local date, freshness, and source tier.
globalContract.retentionRule: Retain only normalized fields needed by the owning feature; discard raw files and provider payloads after a successful atomic import.
globalContract.heroRule: Provider presence never awards XP by itself. Only a versioned, meaningful behavior mapping may submit bounded non-sensitive evidence.
globalContract.idempotencyRule: Use owner-scoped provider identities and deterministic route-versioned keys; retries return the original result and changed input under one key fails visibly.

automation.summary: A GitHub App installed only on user-selected repositories receives signed pull-request webhooks and performs bounded reconciliation with read-only permissions.

userAssistedSteps: Select only the repositories Sabah One may read.
Reconnect explicitly after installation removal or authorization revocation.

credentialBoundary.browser: Receives setup status and normalized records only; no GitHub token or app secret.
credentialBoundary.server: GitHub App credentials remain server-side; installation tokens are short-lived and are not written to account records.
credentialBoundary.account: Store only the installation identifier, selected repository identities, permission snapshot, connection status, and timestamps.

heroMapping.qualification: The connected GitHub identity authored a pull request that GitHub reports merged into a selected repository's default branch.

failureBehavior: Reject unsigned or invalidly signed webhooks.
Treat duplicate deliveries and reconciliation overlap as one source event.
Show rate-limit, revoked-auth, removed-installation, empty, and partial-sync states without inventing activity.
Preserve the last successful normalized record set but label its freshness until reconciliation succeeds.

fallback.behavior: Keep GitHub shown as simulated/disconnected and award no GitHub-derived progress.

costsAndPrerequisites: Registering and configuring a GitHub App is required.
Installation requires personal-repository ownership or repository/organization admin permission.
Supabase Edge Function hosting and secret configuration are required.
No provider price was established by this research; verify current GitHub and hosting terms before implementation.

primaryEvidence.title: Differences between GitHub Apps and OAuth apps
primaryEvidence.finding: GitHub Apps are preferred, support selected repositories, fine-grained permissions, short-lived tokens, and built-in webhooks.

primaryEvidence.title: Choosing permissions for a GitHub App
primaryEvidence.finding: GitHub Apps have no permissions by default and should request only the minimum endpoint permissions.

primaryEvidence.title: Rate limits for the REST API
primaryEvidence.finding: Authenticated and GitHub App requests are rate-limited and clients must surface and respect provider limits.

primaryEvidence.title: Validating webhook deliveries
primaryEvidence.finding: GitHub requires server-side webhook secret storage and X-Hub-Signature-256 validation before processing a delivery.

primaryEvidence.title: Webhook events and payloads
primaryEvidence.finding: GitHub documents pull_request webhook events and delivery headers used by the proposed route.

revisitTriggers: GitHub materially changes GitHub App permissions, token lifetime, webhook signing, or relevant API availability.
A required meaningful event cannot be obtained without repository contents or write permission.

automation.summary: Barclays supports Open Banking account-data sharing, but Sabah One is not an evidenced regulated AISP and cannot connect directly without an approved regulated provider route.

userAssistedSteps: If Barclays currently exposes a transaction export, download it directly while signed in to Barclays.
Upload the file to the signed-in Sabah One import review.
Map and confirm account, date, description, amount, currency, and provider transaction identity before commit.
If no compatible export is available, use the existing manual Finance path.

credentialBoundary.browser: The user selects a local file; no Barclays login, PIN, password, cookie, or Open Banking credential is requested or retained.
credentialBoundary.server: Receives only reviewed normalized finance records in the normal account mutation path.
credentialBoundary.account: Stores normalized account and transaction records, import provenance, source hash, and freshness; never the raw file or banking credentials.

heroMapping.qualification: Importing balances or transactions never awards XP. Only existing versioned savings-transfer or avoidable-spend-improvement behavior may later qualify.

failureBehavior: Reject unknown or ambiguous files before mutation.
Show a reviewable row-level error without logging raw financial data.
Commit accepted rows atomically and make repeated imports idempotent.
Do not offer payments, transfers, or any write-capable banking operation.

fallback.behavior: The user records only the finance behavior needed; no Barclays automation or provider verification is claimed.

costsAndPrerequisites: File import has no new provider prerequisite beyond a user-visible Barclays export, whose current supported formats remain unconfirmed.
Live automation requires an FCA-authorized or registered AISP route, explicit user consent, Open Banking enrolment/certificates or an approved regulated provider, and may carry provider cost.
No regulated provider or price is approved by this ticket.

primaryEvidence.title: Barclays Open Banking
primaryEvidence.finding: Barclays says account data is shared only after explicit permission with registered third-party providers and login details are not shared.

primaryEvidence.title: Open Banking Directory
primaryEvidence.finding: TPP enrolment supplies the profiles, digital certificates, and software statements needed to connect to account providers.

primaryEvidence.title: Account Information Services
primaryEvidence.finding: The current standard limits account-information API access to AISPs with the payment-service user's explicit consent.

unknownFinding.finding: No current Barclays primary source was found that confirms a stable personal transaction-export format suitable for this import contract.
unknownFinding.safeConsequence: KAN-265 must validate a real user-provided sample and current Barclays export instructions before accepting any parser; otherwise it keeps manual Finance entry.

revisitTriggers: A regulated read-only provider is selected with current price, coverage, authorization, and data-retention evidence.
Barclays publishes a stable supported personal export format or changes Open Banking requirements.

automation.summary: An inspectable Apple Shortcut finds iPhone step samples, aggregates one local day, and hands a bounded payload to a signed-in Sabah One review without claiming browser HealthKit access.

userAssistedSteps: Install and inspect the published Shortcut.
Grant the Shortcut read access only to step samples.
Run it for one local day and review the date, range, total, and source before accepting in signed-in Sabah One.

credentialBoundary.browser: Uses the existing in-memory authenticated Sabah One session for confirmation; the handoff is immediately cleared and is never written to browser storage.
credentialBoundary.server: Receives only the confirmed bounded daily summary through a narrow account mutation.
credentialBoundary.account: Stores normalized daily movement provenance and no Apple credential, Health export, location, route, or raw sample list.

heroMapping.qualification: At most one award per local date after a versioned approved daily threshold is met; KAN-266 must not invent that threshold.

failureBehavior: Reject missing permission, malformed dates, invalid totals, future ranges, oversized payloads, and duplicate local-day identities.
Never claim direct HealthKit access from the GitHub Pages browser.
Show the last accepted local date and an explicit run-again action when stale.

fallback.behavior: If Shortcuts cannot run, parse an Apple Health XML export locally and retain only one reviewed daily step summary; if that is too broad, use existing Move progress.

costsAndPrerequisites: Requires an iPhone with Health step data and Apple Shortcuts; no watch is required because Apple documents that iPhone records step samples.
No Apple Developer Program is required; the proposed user-run bridge ends at the hosted Sabah One browser review.
The fallback Health export contains broad sensitive data and is acceptable only with ephemeral browser-side parsing and immediate discard.

primaryEvidence.title: HealthKit
primaryEvidence.finding: HealthKit is the permissioned iPhone and Apple Watch repository used by apps; it is not documented as a browser API.

primaryEvidence.title: stepCount
primaryEvidence.finding: Apple documents that the system automatically records step-count samples on iPhone and Apple Watch.

primaryEvidence.title: Find and Filter actions in Shortcuts
primaryEvidence.finding: Apple Shortcuts includes Find Health Samples.

primaryEvidence.title: Request an API in Shortcuts
primaryEvidence.finding: Shortcuts can make user-built URL requests with bounded JSON, form, or file bodies.

primaryEvidence.title: Share your data in Health on iPhone
primaryEvidence.finding: Apple supports user export of all Health data as XML, which is a broad fallback rather than the preferred minimized route.

revisitTriggers: Apple removes or materially changes Find Health Samples, Shortcuts handoff behavior, or iPhone step recording.
Sabah One gains an explicitly approved native Apple runtime.

automation.summary: Eight Sleep documents app reports, health data, Apple Health linking, and data-access requests, but no supported public read API or routine export contract was confirmed.

userAssistedSteps: Open a finalized Sleep and Health report in the Eight Sleep app.
Record only the local sleep date and that a finalized session exists.
Optionally record the bounded sleep window only if the user chooses; do not copy scores, stages, biometrics, or screenshots.

credentialBoundary.browser: Never requests an Eight Sleep email, password, session cookie, token, or private API endpoint.
credentialBoundary.server: Receives only the user-confirmed normalized summary.
credentialBoundary.account: Stores source label, local date, optional bounded window, report-finalized flag, and acceptance time; no credentials or raw health report.

heroMapping.qualification: One finalized sleep session per local sleep date; it supports a non-medical restorative-habit record only.

failureBehavior: Keep automation visibly unavailable and never call an undocumented private endpoint.
Reject incomplete, future, duplicate, or implausibly long optional windows.
Treat tiredness as a temporary user-reported condition that never subtracts permanent progress.

fallback.behavior: The user may record a general reflection, or skip evidence entirely; Sabah One never fabricates Eight Sleep availability.

costsAndPrerequisites: Requires an existing Eight Sleep device/account and access to finalized app reports; this ticket authorizes no purchase or membership change.
A data-access request is user-assisted, may be slow, and is not suitable as routine sync.
No public API price or developer prerequisite was found because no supported public API was confirmed.

primaryEvidence.title: What data does Eight Sleep collect?
primaryEvidence.finding: Eight Sleep documents sensitive sleep and biometric collection and a user-initiated data-copy request in the app.

primaryEvidence.title: Eight Sleep App Terms and Conditions
primaryEvidence.finding: Eight Sleep documents user-directed third-party sharing and Apple Health connection, but not a Sabah One-compatible public API or data direction contract.

primaryEvidence.title: How do I edit or delete my sleep session?
primaryEvidence.finding: Eight Sleep documents finalized Sleep and Health reports and editable session boundaries, so manual provenance must not be treated as immutable provider verification.

unknownFinding.finding: No current official public developer API, supported routine export, or confirmed outbound Apple Health sleep-data contract was found.
unknownFinding.safeConsequence: KAN-267 must retain the manual self-reported route unless Eight Sleep publishes or explicitly grants a supported read-only contract.

revisitTriggers: Eight Sleep publishes a supported public API, routine export, or clearly documented outbound Apple Health sleep route.
The selected fallback would require biometric or diagnostic data.

automation.summary: The ticket and repository do not identify an official Elif B product URL, legal provider, API, export, or account contract.

userAssistedSteps: Record the course or lesson as a Sabah One Learn activity without copying protected course content.
Mark the activity complete through the existing Learn flow.
Keep the provider label as user-supplied and unverified until an official product identity is supplied.

credentialBoundary.browser: Never requests an Elif B password, cookie, token, screenshot, or browser automation session.
credentialBoundary.server: Uses the existing Learn account mutation only.
credentialBoundary.account: Stores the user-authored activity label, local date, completion state, and normal Learn provenance; no protected lesson content.

heroMapping.qualification: Use the existing Learn level-1 completion mapping once per activity and local date; do not add a second Discipline award for the same action.

failureBehavior: Reject any route that depends on password capture, credentialed scraping, hidden computer use, or copied protected content.
Preserve the existing Learn flow when provider-specific evidence is absent.

fallback.behavior: Existing Learn evidence remains transparent and idempotent without claiming external verification.

costsAndPrerequisites: No new cost or provider prerequisite is approved.
Provider-specific automation remains blocked until the exact official product URL and current API/export terms are supplied and verified.

unknownFinding.finding: Repository and Jira searches found no official Elif B URL or legal provider identity; web searches returned multiple unrelated similarly named Arabic-learning products, so selecting one would be a guess.
unknownFinding.safeConsequence: KAN-268 keeps the existing self-reported Learn route until Sol obtains the exact provider identity and verifies current official capability.

revisitTriggers: The exact official Elif B product URL or app-store identity is supplied.
The verified provider publishes a supported progress API or export.
